## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Stefan Zweig an Hannah; Altmann, Manfred Altmann [Juli 1941], SZ-AAL/B1.144
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.144
- Datum: 07.1941
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 4 Scans

pages.transcription:
Dear Hannah & Manfred we are eagerly expecting your cable
that Manfred has passed his examination and you will has
the well-earned rest in Bath. I wish you would feel happy
there - as much happy as people with human feelings are
able to be in these horrid times. I personally am extremely
depressed by the prospect how many people will suffer before
this beast Hitler will be down but this will on the other
hand be the only possibility to make life worth living. You
are so much younger than I who has no more much time
for waiting and very often I am a bad companion for
Lotte with my black thoughts - but how could it be other
wise in such a time especially if one cannot be active and
useful. I am writing now the story of my life, it will be
a rather long book and I shall try that the end of it will
not be too sad and depressive. Most of the refugee writers
are already here in the country some did find small
possibilities and altogether it is only for those who can
assimilate themselves and write what one likes for read
here, exciting stuff or sensational news; just the best
have the smallest chances, those who take responsibility
for every word. I hope Willi[?] has been able to arrange
all, in the future you would perhaps sometimes apply
to Frost or Wooster for extraordinary occasions. Thanks
also for the news about our faithful bookseller Eidemann[?],
you understand that I was somewhat puzzled that he never
gave me directly news but I know very well what an honest
and reliable friend he is. Now enjoy your holidays, I was
so glad that you had for a whole month quiet nights in
London and I hope you will have rested physical and
mental rest in Bath. Please give my love to all, also

[Randnotiz links, von unten nach oben]:
to Belauin[?] and Roland to whom I will write soon. Yours
Stefan Zweig [?] [?] [?] [?] [?]

[Randnotiz rechts, von unten nach oben]:
Just your letter from June 21st thanks!

pages.confidence_notes: Einige Wörter am linken Rand sind durch das aufgeklebte Zeitungsschnipsel teilweise verdeckt oder schwer lesbar. Die Namen 'Belauin' und 'Eidemann' sind unsicher.
